construction: Sector-pair relative-value reversion translated to long-only 25-name sector-tilt. (1) cap-weighted (LAGGED t-1 cap, C2-safe) daily sector index per RAWDATA Sector (KSI Lv1, 27 sectors). (2) per survivor-core pair (A,B): spread=log(idxA/idxB), trailing 252d rolling z, z LAGGED 1d (PIT: signal at t uses data thru t-1). (3) |z|>=2 => reversion bet: cheap sector +tilt, expensive sector -tilt, magnitude=min(|z|,4). (4) per-stock score = sum of its sector signed tilt across active pairs; long-only => only positive-tilt (cheap-side) names selectable, top-25 EW via canonical_screen_bt. 5 survivor-core pairs ONLY (over-fit avoidance), NOT full 18.
sector_source: RAWDATA Sector (KSI Lv1, 27 sectors), slow-moving PIT-safe. Cap weights from RAWDATA Size, lagged t-1.

factor_specs.formula: spread_{A,B,t}=log(capwt_idx_A,t-1/capwt_idx_B,t-1); z=(spread-rollmean_252)/rollsd_252, lagged 1d; tilt=sign-of-reversion*min(|z|,4) if |z|>=2 else 0; per-stock score=sum_{active pairs} sector_tilt(stock.sector)
factor_specs.lag_rule: price/cap t-1; spread z thru t-1 (lagged 1d); sector classification PIT-safe slow-moving
factor_specs.neutralization: none (sector-tilt IS the signal; long-only cheap-side selection)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Cap-weighted sector indices co-move via shared macro/style exposure; when a survivor-core pair relative valuation (price log-ratio) stretches >2sd from 252d trailing mean, validated tendency is spread mean-reversion (cheap sector outperforms expensive over ~21d). Pairs chosen as BH-FDR q0.10 + clean-walk-forward-OOS survivors (insurance/utility Bonferroni: screen nw_t 4.84 full / 3.96 pre-lockbox / hit 0.73 / n=326). Structural sector-allocation, not idiosyncratic stock-picking.
